title: A9 motorway: car strikes stopped van
location_guess: A9 motorway near Munich, Germany (TUM Traffic gantry cameras)
summary: A white panel van stands stopped in lane 1 (next to the median) of a busy six-lane carriageway; traffic flows around it. The yellow car comes down lane 1, moves out to lane 2 at 20.4 s to overtake, cuts back toward lane 1 at 22.4 s, runs onto the median verge at 22.64 s and strikes the van's median-side rear corner at 23.28 s. The van is shoved forward with the yellow car pressed against its side.

crash.description: Yellow car (lane 1 -> lane 2 -> lane 1) runs onto the snow-covered median verge, its front strikes the stopped white van's median-side rear corner and stays pressed against the van as it is shoved forward.

caveats: Measured frame by frame from the bottom-right (crash) camera at 12.5 fps; the other tiles are context only.
Speeds far from the camera (hundreds of metres) come from few pixels and are less certain than near the crash.
Vehicles appear when the camera first sees them at the horizon; tracks the camera lost at the horizon end there.
Contact forces/impulses are derived from the measured motion and assumed masses, not measured directly.
